about: Modwerk source-only improved-machine-browser package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/improved-machine-browser.

mods.title: Improved Machine Browser
mods.summary: Browse the machine list without loading each machine, and jump between its sections with FUNC + UP or DOWN. YES loads.
mods.description: Stock loads every machine the machine list's outline passes, so the track's sound and SRC page change while you scroll. Here UP, DOWN and the knobs only move the outline: nothing loads until YES, and NO leaves the track as it was. FUNC + DOWN jumps to the first machine of the next section (BD, SD, SY and so on), and FUNC + UP to the top of the current section, then of the one above.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author: build MBC3 (this package's source beside sixteen other modules, linked on the Modwerk base by Modwerk's linker) passed browsing without loading, YES and NO, held arrows, knob turns and FUNC section jumps with the arrows and the knobs. This package's own bytes have not been flashed from the site.
